ms.criteria:

Milestone 2 Submission Report

Project: Boros – Tx Submission for Intense Workloads by TxPipe
Milestone: Fanout Mechanism
Date: 02/12/25
Overview
This milestone focuses on developing and validating the tx fanout mechanism for propagating transactions across multiple peers in the Cardano network. The fanout mechanism is designed to support both static and dynamic topologies and leverages node-to-node protocols to ensure efficient transaction propagation.
Deliverables
The following outputs have been delivered as part of Milestone 2:
・Source Code: GitHub Repository
・Documentation: Documentation
・Test Reports: View Test Report
・Video Demonstration: Watch Video Demo

ms.report:
Milestone 3 Submission Report
Project: Boros – Tx Submission for Intense Workloads by TxPipe
Milestone: Persistence, Monitoring and Retry logic
Date: 02/21/25
Overview
This milestone focuses on implementing persistence, monitoring, and retry mechanisms for transaction processing. The system ensures that transaction requests are reliably stored in message queues. A monitoring component tracks the transaction lifecycle, providing real-time status updates, while a retry mechanism ensures that failed transactions are reprocessed. These features enhance the reliability and resilience of transaction propagation in the Cardano network.
Deliverables
The following outputs have been delivered as part of Milestone 3:
・Source code for persistence mechanism
・Source code for monitoring mechanism
・Source code for retry mechanism
・Documentation: Documentation
・Test Reports: View Test Report
・Video Demonstration: Watch Video Demo
